name: Lana’thel breaks the blade

date.label: Before the Wrath restoration quest; exact date unknown

summary: At Quel’Delar’s Rest, a more recent memory darkens the snow. Lana’thel recounts how the sword passed from Thalorien into her hands after his fall, and how, as the Lich King’s servant, she was ordered to destroy it. She carried Quel’Delar north and broke it here. Her account joins a knight’s last defense to a queen’s enslavement; the broken hilt at the quest’s opening is the remnant of that command.
